content.title: [Weather] Rain or snow along the East Coast until the afternoon... Large daily temperature range ...
content.text: Rain or snow is expected to fall mainly along the East Coast until this afternoon. Precipitation along the East Coast will be around 5mm, while 1 to 5cm of snow will accumulate in mountainous areas with lower temperatures. Many roads will be slippery as the rain or snow freezes, so please travel with caution. Tomorrow, the skies across the country will be generally cloudy, and air quality will be moderate. Frost may occur in some inland areas between dawn and morning. Please pay attention to crop management. Tomorrow morning temperatures will start chilly in Seoul at 3 degrees, but will become mild during the day, rising to 12 degrees in Seoul and 14 degrees in Daejeon. Looking at the southern regions, morning temperatures will start at minus 4 degrees in Andong, rising to 15 degrees in Daegu and Gwangju during the day, resulting in a large diurnal temperature range. Starting tomorrow, strong swell waves will roll in along the East Coast and the Jeju coast. Please be careful of safety accidents along the coast. There is no significant snow or rain forecast for this weekend and holiday, so there will be no major inconvenience for outdoor activities. However, as the daily temperature range will be large, please take good care of your health. That concludes the weather report.
